relationships.ikki-kurogane: His unresolved rivalry with Ikki fuels his refusal to stop before Tendo's impossible attack.

periods.summary: Kuraudo is called from the Tokyo conscription scene by Moroboshi because his reflexes and Orochimaru can compensate for Moroboshi's inability to approach Tendo. Moroboshi enchants Orochimaru with Tiger Bite, forming the combined technique Gluttonous Serpent. Kuraudo rushes through Tendo's tornado, lightning, heat rays, and debris barrages with an evolved personal version of Ten'i Muhou called Akuro-o. He wounds Tendo and then holds back the enormous Ame-no-Murakumo by repeatedly shaving it down with Tiger Bite-coated blades. Remembering his rivalry with Ikki, he refuses to retreat from certain death, destroys the sword, and creates the decisive opening for Moroboshi, though his Device and magic are spent before he can land the final blow.

key_events.summary: Moroboshi contacts Ayatsuji to bring Kuraudo to Kyushu despite the Tokyo emergency summons.
Uses Gluttonous Serpent and Akuro-o to pierce Tendo's disaster defenses and block Ame-no-Murakumo.

abilities: Gluttonous Serpent / Ouroboros with Tiger Bite enchantment
